game.name: Ncaa Football 09 (USA)
game.desc: EA's long running college football franchise returns, featuring the obligatory rosters updates as well as brand new animations and offensive/defensive plays. It features the standard Dynasty Mode, Exhibition, Multiplayer and now has the option to play football games with team mascots in full uniform. It also features minigames to train QBs, RBs as well as linebackers and even kickers.
